Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.25, Lucknow imposing a sentence of 6 months simple imprisonment and a fine of Rs.1,000/- in Criminal Case No.2116 of 1987 under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act (for short 'the Act'), Police Station Madiyaon, District Lucknow and judgment and order dated 08.08.2007 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.9, Lucknow in Criminal Appeal No.150 of 2007 convicting and sentencing the revisionist under Section 7/16 of the Act to undergo six months simple imprisonment with fine of Rs.1,000/-.

sentences.text: The facts of the case are that on 24.02.7983 at around 10.15 A.M. the Food Inspector had found the revisionist selling milk.
The Food Inspector took sample of the milk from the revisionist and after issuing notice on Form No.6 and purchased it by paying the milk amount.
He prepared three samples as required and sent it for Public Analyst for examination.
The Public Analyst in his report found that there was deficiency of fat about 13% from the normal one.

sentences.text: The trial court after considering the evidence and the submissions, had convicted and sentenced the revisionist as mentioned above.
Aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment, revisionist preferred appeal, which too was dismissed vide impugned judgement and order.
4. The incident is of the year 1986.
33 years gone by since the samples were taken.
The trial court judgment is dated 15.05.2007.

5. Considering the fact that the incident had happened 33 years before and also considering the judgement of the Supreme Court rendered in the case of Nand Lal v. State of Uttarakhand and others, 2010 (4) SCC 562, in which the Supreme Court after considering the age of the appellant in that case and taking into account the fact that the incident was very old, reduced the sentence to the period already undergone, interest of justice would meet if upholding the conviction, but reduce the sentence to the period already undergone with some fine.

entities.text: Nand Lal v. State of Uttarakhand and others, 2010 (4) SCC 562
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Accordingly, the conviction of the revisionist is upheld, but reduce the sentence to the period already undergone with a fine of Rs.25,000/-, to be deposited by the revisionist within a period of one month.

7. With the aforesaid observation and direction, the revision is partly allowed while maintaining the conviction, but the sentence is reduced to the period already undergone with a fine of Rs.25,000/-.
